usage.source_scope: Instance-centric panoptic occupancy labels, actor/background mesh export, and physically consistent mesh voxelization tooling.
usage.project_application: Audit one matched CARLA scene by comparing the current DTR truth path with CarlaOcc-style mesh voxelization on voxel agreement, instance consistency, and route-tube contact parity before considering any larger data import.
usage.modifications: Treat the UE5 0.10.0 pipeline as a truth-design reference, not a drop-in replacement for the frozen CARLA 0.9.16 source. Preserve simulator/version provenance and do not download the full dataset for the first canary.
usage.expected_effect: Reveal whether current occupancy truth has a decision-changing instance or voxelization defect. Stop if differences are explained only by resolution or simulator-version mismatch, or if route-tube contact is unchanged.

evaluation.setup: Candidate one-scene truth-generation audit; no full dataset acquisition planned.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Synthetic panoptic occupancy truth is not source-disjoint real-world confirmation, phone sensing, natural pedestrian behavior, Android performance, user benefit, product readiness, or safety evidence.

evidence.summary: Official project repository verified for 100K frames, up-to-0.05 m panoptic occupancy, mesh export, physical voxelization, and the CARLA UE5 0.10.0 requirement.

history.change: Added as a bounded truth-generation reference with an explicit one-scene audit and simulator-version stop condition.
